object: row-17 exact DP dependency on prefix offsets
question: Does the fixed-q row-17 DP count change under local prefix-derived carry offsets?
number: Published fixed-q count is 65536; seven one-bit/word offset probes all remain 65536; 64 random offset pairs range from 0 to 65536, so the count is not invariant under arbitrary offsets.
notes: Exact local dependency probe with the published q held fixed. It is not a valid-prefix generator and does not replay rows 19--37; therefore it cannot close the universal r38 prefix-generality cell or provide filing credit.
held_fixed: Published q=(ex,ax,ey,ay,wx) and row-17 constraint masks; varied only local ca/ce/cy offsets.
reopen_if: Repeat the exact DP and full rows 19--37 over independently generated valid SHA-256-r38 prefixes, or prove prefix invariance.
